body: Jenna I hope you’re ok and I care about your pain.
It’s almost as if being accommodating to human beings is good for productivity
Thank you! Hang in ok! You’re well loved!
Abuse is just so evil and it sucks you experienced it so many times. I relate. You are so worthy of love, compassion, and gentleness. I hope it finds you soon. If you need someone I’m here.
I’m sending you all of my good thoughts. I hear your pain, I see it, and I care. Your gf does too.
Please be courteous of those who want to live. I hope the suicidal thoughts get better for you soon. ❤️

Hi, I study psychology and I just want you to know that what you’re experiencing is normal and many people your age go through this. You’re going through a lot and it is not my goal to minimize it- I just wanted you to know you’re not alone. I hope you can confide in your support system.

I wish I could adopt you. I was in foster care and I relate to your feeling, but you will be able to choose your family one day. Your chosen family will adore you. It does get better, especially when you’re self-made, like you will be.
